## What this changes

<!-- A sentence or two, in plain words. -->

## Zero harm checklist

- [ ] **No tracking.** No analytics, cookies, ads, accounts, or files loaded from other websites.
- [ ] **No personal details.** No student names, photos, voices, identifying stories, email addresses or phone numbers.
- [ ] **No pressure.** No streaks that punish, public rankings of children, guilt-based messages, or dark patterns.
- [ ] **Works without AI.** Any new activity has a way to take part without using AI, and AI use for under-13s stays teacher-led.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] **Accessible.** Headings in order, labels on controls, visible focus, keyboard use, and enough contrast.
- [ ] **Plain language.** Someone non-technical can understand what each part is for.
- [ ] **Offline.** If I added a file the app needs, I listed it in `PRECACHE` in `site/sw.js`.
- [ ] **Sources.** New facts or figures have a dated source.
- [ ] **Checked.** I ran `node tools/check-site.mjs` (the workflow runs it too).
